'''Sallen Fandel''' was an old [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] type who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], he was knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien races]], bureaucracy, and security, and was skilled in bargaining, command, and using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. He wore [[Boot/Legends|boots]], pants and a [[Jacket/Legends|coat]] and carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sallen Fandel was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Fandel's character type was listed as "Senatorial Type" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
